name: Magician
summary: A spell-focused performer who manipulates magical energy, counterspells, and an expanded arcane repertoire.

features.name: Dweomercraft +1
features.summary: Grant allies a bonus on caster-level checks, concentration checks, and attack rolls with spells and spell-like abilities.
features.scaling: +1; increases at 5th level and every 6 levels thereafter

features.name: Spell Suppression
features.summary: Track continuous performance rounds and spend an immediate action to counter an identified spell whose level does not exceed those rounds.
features.scaling: counterspell limit equals continuous performance rounds

features.name: Metamagic Mastery
features.summary: End your performance to apply a metamagic feat to your next spell without increasing its casting time; the higher-level slot is still required.

features.name: Magical Talent
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Knowledge (arcana), Spellcraft, and Use Magic Device checks.

features.name: Improved Counterspell
features.summary: Gain Improved Counterspell as a bonus feat.

features.name: Extended Performance
features.summary: Sacrifice a spell slot as a swift action to let a performance linger one round per spell level after concentration ends.

features.name: Expanded Repertoire Spell 1
features.summary: Add one spell you can cast from any arcane spell list to your spells known.

features.name: Expanded Repertoire Spell 2
features.summary: Add another legal arcane spell to your spells known.

features.name: Expanded Repertoire Spell 3
features.summary: Add another legal arcane spell to your spells known.

features.name: Expanded Repertoire Spell 4
features.summary: Add another legal arcane spell to your spells known.

features.name: Expanded Repertoire Spell 5
features.summary: Add another legal arcane spell to your spells known.

features.name: Arcane Bond
features.summary: Bond with a non-weapon object and use it to cast one additional known spell once per day.

features.name: Wand Mastery: Charisma DC
features.summary: Use your Charisma modifier to determine the save DC of wands containing spells on your spell list.

features.name: Wand Mastery: Caster Level
features.summary: Use your own caster level instead of a qualifying wand's caster level.
